questions.question: If 1st March 2011 was Monday, what day was 1st April 2011?
questions.explanation: March has 31 days. 31/7 gives 3 remainder. Monday + 3 = Thursday. Wait, 31 days = 4 weeks + 3 days. Mon + 3 = Thu. Let's re-calculate: Mon(1), Tue(2), Wed(3), Thu(4). 1st April is the 32nd day. 31 remainder 3. Mon + 3 = Thursday. (Correction: April 1 is Friday if March 1 is Tuesday). With March 1 as Mon: Mon + 3 odd days = Thursday.
